title: 第12章 作画人第13章 左撇子
content_zh:
一路上，白月循着记忆找到了祝星洲所在的摊位，却见那摊位空空如也，并未能见到人。
随后的云风赶到时，也是一副果然如此的神情。
白月看着眼前空荡荡的摊位，低下了小脑袋瓜思索了一阵，便走到附近的摊位去打听。
却不想这些摊主虽在同一处摆摊，但大多都素不相识。
就算有所交流，也没有多少人会去注意那么一个角落里的黑衣少年。
见询问无果，白月也有一些无奈。
心想着只好等到下周再来了，便扯过一旁的云风就要往回走去。
“小姑娘？你是在找小洲吗？”
忽的，白月听到身后响起了一个陌生的声音。
转过头望去，只见叫住她的是一个端着菜篮子的白发老婆婆，看样子像是从古玩街旁的市场买完菜经过的。
“是哒婆婆，你认识祝星洲吗？”
看到老婆子能叫得出小洲这样的称谓，想来应该是他的熟人，白月也好像看到了希望。
“我刚才听摊上的人说有个小姑娘在找小洲，他们跟我说就是前面刚走不远的小丫头，身边还跟着一个约莫十五六岁的少年，想来就是你了。”
“你是要来找小洲买东西的吗？”
老婆子看到白月白白嫩嫩的小模样，长得可真像观音菩萨座下的那善财童子，让老人家瞧着就是欢喜。
看着这面善的老婆婆，白月也卖乖的回答着。
“是的婆婆，我们要找他买些东西，就是不知道他今天为什么不摆摊了，婆婆能帮我们找到他吗？”
说着，一双眨巴着的大眼睛，期盼的看着面前的老婆婆。
“唉...小洲家里有些急事，最近一段时间怕是都不能出来摆摊了，不过我就住在他们家附近，你们若是真想找他买东西的话，我可以给你们带路。”
婆婆说着，便领着二人，步履蹒跚的朝着另一个方向走去。

白月二人相互对视一眼，也跟着老婆婆的方向走。
期间一个还帮着老婆婆拎着菜篮子，一个扶着老婆婆慢慢走，听着老婆婆说起祝星洲家里的事，这一路走得也不算无聊。
听婆婆说，祝星洲家里原本有着一家三口。
但自从五年前，有一群人从他们家里把他的父亲给带走了，他的母亲也因为这件事而离家出走，剩下祝星洲孤零零一人。
老婆婆看着不忍心，便把他接到自己家住了。
但老婆婆也只是孤寡老人，子女都不在身边，年幼的祝星洲只好把家里仅剩的物件都拿到古玩街上去摆摊来维持生计。
好在家里的物件品相都极好，加上祝星洲狡黠的性子，还能卖得个好价钱，一老一小也生活得还不错。
直到前年，他的父亲突然一身狼狈的跑回了家，后来听说是得了重病，医院都说不能治好，只能一直在家养着。
content_en:
Along the way, Bai Yue followed her memory and found the stall where Zhu Xingzhou was, but found that the stall was empty and no one could be seen.
When Yunfeng arrived later, he had the same expression as expected.
Bai Yue looked at the empty stalls in front of her, lowered her head and thought for a while, then walked to a nearby stall to inquire.
But I didn’t expect that although these stall owners set up stalls in the same place, most of them were strangers to each other.
Even if there was communication, not many people would pay attention to the young man in black in the corner.
Seeing that the inquiry was fruitless, Bai Yue also felt helpless.
Thinking that I had to wait until next week to come again, I pulled Yunfeng aside and walked back.
"Little girl? Are you looking for Xiaozhou?"
Suddenly, Bai Yue heard a strange voice behind her.
Turning her head and looking around, she saw that the person who stopped her was an old woman with white hair carrying a vegetable basket. She looked like she was passing by after buying vegetables from the market next to the antique street.
"Yes, grandma, do you know Zhu Xingzhou?"
Seeing that the old woman could call her Xiaozhou, she must be an acquaintance of his, Bai Yue seemed to see hope.
"I just heard from people at the stall that there is a little girl looking for Xiaozhou. They told me that she is the little girl who just walked in front of me. There is also a boy about fifteen or sixteen years old with her. I think it is you."
"Are you coming to Xiaozhou to buy something?"
When the old lady saw Bai Yue's white and tender appearance, she really looked like the good-fortune boy under the seat of Guanyin Bodhisattva, which made the old lady happy.
Looking at the kind-faced old woman, Bai Yue answered obediently.
"Yes, mother-in-law, we want to buy some things from him, but we just don't know why he didn't set up a stall today. Can mother-in-law help us find him?"
As he spoke, a pair of big blinking eyes looked expectantly at the old woman in front of him.
"Sigh... Xiaozhou has something urgent at home. I'm afraid he won't be able to set up a stall for a while. But I live near their house. If you really want to buy something from him, I can show you the way."
As the mother-in-law said, she led the two of them towards the other direction with unsteady steps.
Bai Yue and the two looked at each other and followed the old woman's direction.
During this period, one of them helped the old woman carry the vegetable basket, and the other helped the old woman walk slowly, listening to the old woman talking about Zhu Xingzhou's family affairs. The walk was not boring.
According to my mother-in-law, Zhu Xingzhou’s family originally had a family of three.
But since five years ago, a group of people took his father away from their home, and his mother also ran away from home because of this incident, leaving Zhu Xingzhou alone.
The old woman couldn't bear it, so she took him to live in her home.
But the old woman was just a lonely old woman, and her children were not around. The young Zhu Xingzhou had no choice but to take all the remaining items at home to set up a stall on the antique street to make ends meet.
Fortunately, the items at home are in excellent condition, and with Zhu Xingzhou's cunning temperament, they can still be sold at a good price, so the old and young are living a pretty good life.
Until the year before last, his father suddenly ran home in a mess. Later, he heard that he was seriously ill. The hospital said he could not be cured and had to stay at home.
